title: Let an operator read a store's active obligation rule set and apply the same set on another host's store
outcome: Let an operator read a store's active obligation rule set and apply the same set on another host's store
acceptance: `engram control-policy show` (or a sibling read) can print the active obligation rule set's full typed content, not only its record id, in a form `control-policy set-obligation-rule-set --input @file` accepts unchanged
A behaviour test exports the rule set from one store, applies it to a fresh store, and both stores then report the same rule-set CONTENT (record ids differ by design)

docs/features/cli-host-and-operator.md documents comparing and aligning a second host's store (e.g. Windows B) with the home store's acceptance and obligation policy, and says plainly that `obligation_rules` is a record id
